verdict.rationale: A payments and POS platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents a managed MCP server, an Agent Toolkit, and llms.txt docs, all of which let external AI clients and agents connect to SumUp. None of it shows a built-in assistant inside the SumUp product that users can hand tasks to. These are adjacent developer building blocks and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
